scope: bounded regional, public-datasets-only, non-operational technical preview

recommended_strategy.candidate: Continue the isolated 26bc0b4 beta/RC campaign; do not freeze a new RC before beta duration and cycle criteria pass.
recommended_strategy.evidence: Use GitHub Actions as the primary hosted evidence plane and retain Hugging Face or an institutional repository as a secondary preservation target.
recommended_strategy.review: Use a panel of content-bound agents for qualification; panels assess evidence but do not create elapsed, participant, provider-acceptance or owner-authority facts.
recommended_strategy.authority: Keep the tier-specific release decision unsigned and non-authorizing until every required gate is evidenced.

stable_gate_families.evidence: frozen conformance corpus and compatibility qualification
rights-qualified representative data and source authority
two isolated reproductions against the exact candidate
owner-signed tier decision with scope, exclusions, expiry, rollback and revocation

repository_owned_next_steps: retain immutable candidate and daily hosted schedule
validate each observation against revision, epoch, timestamps, SLO and incident fields
refresh the gate snapshot and panel packet after each qualifying observation
maintain recovery, benchmark and preservation manifests without calling them production evidence
prepare the owner decision packet but do not sign or promote
non_substitutions: Retrospective data cannot replace elapsed beta or RC soak.
Agent panels cannot replace factual external operator/user participation.
Local or technical-preview recovery cannot replace production-representative hosted recovery.
A draft decision cannot authorize beta, RC or stable-v1 promotion.
